title: Keith's porch pedestals are too wide, the old plan shows
items: Nothing you can see moved yet. The floor plan printed under the 1888 magazine plate draws the stone pedestals under 1808 Prairie's porch columns about 0.6 m wide, not the model's 0.9 m, and puts the south pair about 0.4 m further south. The plate's own photograph and a 1965 colour slide both agree with the plan, so the porch will be rebuilt to it next, and the 1965 view has been lined up again so it can be checked when that lands.
